subject.gist: Dave built machinery before making a camper that still carries cargo; he heats his sleeping bag and admits his insulating curtains haven’t worked.

story.text: Dave brings a career building winery machinery to a camper that also has to replace his pickup. Fold the bed panels up and remove the table, and his Transit can carry timber again. The shower doubles as storage and counter space, while a portable stove lets him cook outside. Everything earns its room, and lessons from his previous van shape this one, right down to a bed long enough for his outstretched toes. He is candid about experiments: the insulated curtains are not keeping him warmer. Instead, a heating pad warms his sleeping bag. His approach is to keep asking questions, reading and adjusting things until they work.
